value.title: Useful updates, just around the corner.
value.body: Discover short videos posted by your neighbors within 300 m, 1 km, or 3 km.
points: Local alerts, helping out, events, and good finds.
Record on site; posts expire according to their category.
Your public location is approximate. Content can be reported.

permissions.title: Permissions explained before we ask
permissions.body: Before your browser asks for permission, we explain what it is for. You can say no and change your mind later.
permissions.camera: Camera and microphone — only while recording.
permissions.location: Location — to show and publish nearby. It is not saved while you browse; published video locations are rounded to about 50 m for everyone.
permissions.notifications: Notifications — if you want nearby alerts, at most once every 30 minutes.

install.title: Install the app
install.body: Add Neighbors Live to your Home Screen for a full-screen experience, faster access, and optional notifications.
install.ios: On iPhone or iPad (Safari): tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen.” On iOS, notifications only work after installing the app and opening it from its icon.
install.android: On Android (Chrome): use the button below or the ⋮ menu, then “Install app.”

rules.title: Community rules
points: Record useful neighborhood events, not people. Automatic face blurring may miss someone; license plates are not blurred.
No precise addresses, harassment, or public shaming.
In an emergency, call 112 first. Neighbors Live is not an emergency service.
Report concerning content. After 3 reports, a video is hidden for review.
